title: MRI of the lumbar spine for low back pain
disclaimer: Illustrative criteria written for this demo project. Not an actual Medicare, Medicaid, or commercial payer policy.

criteria.text: Low back pain has persisted for at least 6 weeks.
At least 6 weeks of documented conservative therapy (e.g., physical therapy, NSAIDs, activity modification) without adequate improvement.
Red-flag findings: suspected cauda equina syndrome, progressive neurological deficit, suspected malignancy or infection, or significant trauma. (Meeting C3 alone is sufficient.)
